title: FoldCanvas FoldScript
description: Portable 2D-first source contract for deterministic FoldCanvas geometry compilation.

schemaVersion.description: Exact FoldScript contract version interpreted by the importer.

assetId.description: Stable machine identifier for the complete source asset.

displayName.description: Human-readable asset name; it has no geometric effect.

units.description: Physical unit used by all source lengths in this document.

canvas.description: Metadata for the authoritative 2D appearance image.

panels.description: Ordered 2D source domains that are tessellated into geometry.

seams.description: Ordered named relationships between panel boundaries; declaring a seam alone does not execute it.

operations.description: Geometry program executed strictly in array order.

compile.description: Validation, normal-generation, tolerance, and allocation-safety settings.

extensions.description: Namespaced forward-compatible metadata; unknown extension data must not change core geometry.

id.description: Case-sensitive stable identifier used for references and diagnostics.

finiteNumber.description: Finite scalar within the supported interchange range.

positiveNumber.description: Finite scalar strictly greater than zero.

normalizedVec2.description: Two-component panel-normalized coordinate ordered as [u, v], with both components inside [0,1].

positiveVec2.description: Strictly positive two-component vector ordered as [x, y].

vec3.description: Three-component vector ordered as [x, y, z].

rect.description: Normalized canvas rectangle ordered as [x, y, width, height]. The compiler also verifies that the complete rectangle remains inside the canvas.

appearance.description: Forward-slash project-relative image reference resolved under Assets/ or Packages/ by the M08 importer; absolute paths, URI schemes, backslashes, and traversal segments are forbidden.

width.description: Source image width in pixels for validation and authoring tools.

height.description: Source image height in pixels for validation and authoring tools.

rectanglePanel.description: Planar rectangular source domain emitted as a deterministic row-major grid.

id.description: Unique panel identifier referenced by seams and operations.

canvasRect.description: Region of the appearance canvas mapped across this panel.

physicalSize.description: Physical [width, height] of the planar panel in document units.

uSegments.description: Number of horizontal cells; each row contains uSegments + 1 vertices.

vSegments.description: Number of vertical cells; the grid contains vSegments + 1 rows.

diskPanel.description: Planar disk or ellipse emitted as one center vertex plus deterministic concentric rings.

id.description: Unique panel identifier referenced by seams and operations.

shape.description: Selects disk semantics; unequal physical dimensions create an ellipse.

canvasRect.description: Region of the appearance canvas mapped across this disk or ellipse.

physicalSize.description: Physical [diameterX, diameterY] in document units; unequal values create an ellipse.

radialSegments.description: Samples around each ring, starting at +X and advancing counter-clockwise when viewed from +Z.

radialRings.description: Number of concentric rings outside the center vertex.

boundaryRef.description: Reference to one ordered named boundary generated by a panel.

panel.description: ID of the panel that owns the boundary.

boundary.description: Generated boundary ID, such as uMin, uMax, vMin, vMax, or perimeter.

span.description: Optional normalized non-wrapping arc-length interval [startT,endT] in authored boundary order. Runtime validation requires startT < endT. Omission selects the complete boundary.

seam.description: Topology intent between two ordered panel boundaries; resolved only when selected by a stitch operation.

id.description: Unique seam identifier referenced by operations and diagnostics.

mode.description: weld unions paired logical topology; bridge emits a deterministic connecting strip without unioning the two sides. hinge and keepOpen remain declarative and return a stable unsupported-mode diagnostic if selected for execution.

reverseB.description: Reverse boundary B sample order before matching it to boundary A.

sampleCount.description: Minimum requested correspondence density, limited to 8192 in both JSON and native ScriptableObject compilation. Stitch retains both boundaries' normalized arc-length breakpoints and adds a uniform grid when positive, so the final paired count may exceed this value. Zero uses the natural breakpoint union.

id.description: Unique operation identifier used by diagnostics.

rigidTransform.description: Applies component scale, Euler rotation, and translation to one panel while preserving source metadata.

id.description: Unique operation identifier used by diagnostics.

panel.description: ID of the panel to transform.

translation.description: Translation [x, y, z] in document units.

rotationEuler.description: Unity-compatible Euler rotation [x, y, z] in degrees.

scale.description: Component-wise local scale [x, y, z] applied before rotation and translation.

fold.description: Rotates samples on one selected side of a directed source line around that line's stable current 3D embedding. The crease must already be a continuous mesh-edge chain; topology splitting is deferred.

id.description: Unique operation identifier used by diagnostics.

panel.description: ID of the panel containing the fold line.

line.description: Directed hinge line [A, B] in panel-normalized [0,1] coordinates; A and B must differ.

side.description: positive selects points left of directed line A to B; negative selects points right of it.

angleDegrees.description: Signed rotation about the directed A-to-B hinge axis, matching Unity Quaternion.AngleAxis.

falloff.description: Normalized smooth-bend influence width. Zero is the M02 rigid crease; nonzero values are reserved and currently return FC3009.

roll.description: M03 maps one rectangle dimension onto a circular arc in the target's current rigid planar frame; this is not a rigid rotation and does not weld coincident boundaries.

id.description: Unique operation identifier used by diagnostics.

panel.description: ID of the panel to wrap.

direction.description: u wraps panel X around an axis parallel to +Y; v wraps panel Y around an axis parallel to +X.

angleDegrees.description: Signed Circular Roll sweep from the minimum source edge to the maximum edge. M03 supports at most one turn; +/-360 makes edge positions coincide but does not weld them.

radiusMode.description: preserveArcLength derives radius from source span and sweep; explicit uses radius; fitTargetBoundary is reserved for a seam solver.

radius.description: Positive roll radius in document units, required only for explicit mode.

targetSeam.description: Seam constraint to fit, required only for fitTargetBoundary mode.

startAngleDegrees.description: Angular placement of the minimum source edge before applying the signed sweep.

sphericalWrap.description: Maps one explicit rectangle parameter panel into the target's current congruent planar frame using documented spherical latitude/longitude coordinates. It is a deformation rule, not a sphere generator.

id.description: Unique operation identifier used by diagnostics.

panel.description: ID of the rectangle parameter panel to map.

radius.description: Positive sphere radius in document units, measured from the resolved current panel origin.

latitudeRange.description: Signed [start, end] latitude range in degrees. Endpoints must remain inside [-90, 90] and the span must be non-zero.

longitudeRange.description: Signed [start, end] longitude range in degrees. Runtime validation limits the absolute span to one full turn.

wrapDirection.description: longitudeAlongU maps source U to longitude and V to latitude; longitudeAlongV swaps those roles.

poleMode.description: merge uses one render pole per panel fan; keepFan retains per-cell render UV splits while sharing one logical pole identity.

subdivisionMode.description: M05 panelGrid uses the panel's authored U/V segment counts. Adaptive policies are not implemented.

toroidalWrap.description: M09 maps one explicit rectangle parameter panel into a toroidal surface in its current congruent planar frame. Boundary positions may coincide at full turns, but topology closes only through explicit Stitch-selected seams.

id.description: Unique operation identifier used by diagnostics.

panel.description: ID of the rectangle parameter panel to map.

majorRadius.description: Positive distance from the resolved frame origin to the tube centerline, in document units. Runtime requires majorRadius > minorRadius.

minorRadius.description: Positive tube radius in document units. Runtime requires minorRadius < majorRadius.

majorAngleRange.description: Signed [start,end] centerline-angle range in degrees. Runtime requires a non-zero span of at most one turn.

minorAngleRange.description: Signed [start,end] tube-profile-angle range in degrees. Runtime requires a non-zero span of at most one turn.

wrapDirection.description: majorAlongU maps source U to the centerline angle and V to the tube profile; majorAlongV swaps those roles.

stitch.description: Resolves named seams in listed order through deterministic normalized arc-length correspondence. M04 executes weld and bridge; hinge and keepOpen remain declarative.

id.description: Unique operation identifier used by diagnostics.

seams.description: One or more seam IDs resolved in the listed order.

solidify.description: Creates consistently wound outer and inner shells from the final selected topology and adds side walls only on true open topology edges.

id.description: Unique operation identifier used by diagnostics.

targets.description: Panel IDs to thicken. Selection must include every render copy in each selected welded topology group.

thickness.description: Total shell thickness in document units.

direction.description: inward keeps the current surface outside; outward keeps it inside; centered offsets half the thickness in both directions.

compileSettings.description: Compiler tolerances, output-normal policy, validation level, and cumulative allocation limits.

weldEpsilon.description: Positive physical-distance tolerance used by explicit weld and coincidence checks after unit conversion; it never welds implicitly.

recalculateNormals.description: Whether the Unity mesh adapter derives normals after geometry compilation.

validationLevel.description: Requested validation cost: basic, standard, or strict.

maxGeneratedVertices.description: Cumulative vertex limit checked before allocation; exceeding it is an error, not a simplification request.

maxGeneratedTriangles.description: Cumulative triangle limit checked before allocation; exceeding it is an error, not a simplification request.
